desc: The Canik Mete MC9 is chambered in 9x19 mm with a capacity of 10+1 The MC9 supports an overall length of 6.1 inches, a width of just 1.12 inches, a height of 4.52 inches (with magazine), a barrel length of 3.18 inches, and an unloaded weight of a mere 21.2 ounces. The Mete MC9 comes optics-ready with 100% co-witness capability.
